title: Sergey Brin puts Malibu estate on the market for $33.5M
summary_full: Sergey Brin and Nicole Shanahan have decided to sell their Malibu home for $33.5 million. After initially listing it as a luxury rental for $175,000, they opted to sell. The home includes five bedrooms and offers direct access to Little Dume Beach. Previously owned by pop singer Pink, the estate features impressive amenities and ocean views. Brin continues to invest in Malibu real estate, owning multiple properties in the area.
